label: Claude Fable 5.2 run 1 - effort high, 128K cap
notes: Run 1 of 3. 135 findings, no penalties. Full catches on both halves of A1 (11-1 unscheduled, 10-1 unplanned), B1 (22'-10" + 11'-5" = 34'-3" within A2.01B), B3 (from both the 1-1/2" rigid callout vs the drawn 1" layer and the stated-total framing), B4 (names the C-D grid 6'-10 1/2" vs 6'-11 1/2" and the 72'-0 1/2" vs 72'-1 1/2" chains) and B5 (stair headroom undimensioned on A3.22, not the Powder Room). G8 is the porch 1/4":12 against the specified snap-lock panel, same as Grok 4.7 run 2. Partials: D2 0.5 (E-1 1/2" label vs 2" dimension, never tied to R-10, same as GPT-6.1 Sol run 1); D5 0.5 (identifies sheathing outboard of the foam on E-2/E-3/E-4 but frames it as a structural/shear question, not condensation); D6 0.5 (spec says 'see drawings for air sealing' and the drawings show no air barrier or air-sealing details, but no transitions are named); E5 0.5 (climbable horizontal cable at the pool plus a generic missing cable-railing detail, no 4" opening); E6 0.5 (make-up air listed as an open spec question, no 650 CFM trigger); C8 0.5 by the wet-laid rule; G16 0.5 (names the right walls but says no acoustic wall type exists on A4.00, same call as Opus 5.5 run 2). E8 is 0.5: it puts the missing closer on door 16-2, but on A2.01B 16-1 is the door in the garage's south wall to the North Hallway and 16-2 sits south of the hallway, so this is the right defect on the wrong tag (Gemini 4 Argon run 3 precedent). E1 rests on E-12 ('a 7'-0" door only 1'-10" wide') plus F-9 (non-standard width), scored 1.0 by the Fable 5.1 precedent for a bare 1'-10" flag. Stair read correctly as 18 risers (N33, not I8). Unlisted and not scored, for the spot-check: F-3 shower floor with no pan liner or membrane (High), F-2 large-format stone thin-set to a single subfloor (High), pool west-end grade -11'-4" vs -11'-0" (Certain), and a 2x10 stud on 4/A4.10 vs the 2x8 E-2 wall. Misses: A2, A3, B6, C6, C9, D3, D4, F1, F2, F4, G1, G2, G10, G13, G14.

categories.label: Schedule-to-Drawing
categories.desc: Door and window schedule entries that conflict with what is drawn on plans or elevations — wrong widths, wrong materials, wrong finishes for the assigned room.

categories.label: Dimensional / Geometric
categories.desc: Dimension discrepancies between sheets, conflicting datums, wall assembly totals that don't match their component layers, and missing code-critical dimensions.

categories.label: Spec-to-Drawing Conflicts
categories.desc: Conflicts between the project specifications and the drawn documents — different products, different quantities, different performance requirements, different assembly configurations.

categories.label: Building Envelope
categories.desc: Vapor control, air barrier continuity, insulation placement and values, flashing details, and whether wall and roof assemblies perform appropriately for the project climate.

categories.label: Code and Life Safety
categories.desc: Egress paths, minimum door and railing dimensions, fire separation requirements, makeup air for exhaust systems, and other conditions requiring code compliance.

categories.label: Constructability
categories.desc: Whether details can physically be built as drawn — door swing clearances, missing flashing, system conflicts, and architectural elements that require coordination not shown.

categories.label: Completeness and Clarity
categories.desc: Missing tags, orphaned keynotes, TBD items that prevent accurate bidding, dead cross-references, deferred design decisions, and annotations that are ambiguous or absent.
